title: ageria ovalis
intro: Ageria ovalis, commonly known as the "Maidenhair Tree," is a plant species native to Australia and Southeast Asia. The plant has been used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Ageria ovalis include its use as an antispasmodic and cough suppressant, providing relief from respiratory problems. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
